messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday (or a holiday that falls on a weekday but is commonly observed with a day off on the adjacent weekend day).  Provincial variations are noted where relevant.

| Date | Holiday | Day of Week | Notes / Province(s) |
|------|---------|-------------|---------------------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day | Monday | Observed in Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, Manitoba, New Brunswick, and Prince Edward Island (not in BC, NB, PEI, etc.) |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Friday | Federal & provincial holiday |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | Federal & provincial holiday |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Monday | Federal & provincial holiday |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | Federal & provincial holiday |
| **Nov 11** | Remembrance Day | Monday | Federal & provincial holiday |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | Federal & provincial holiday |

### Quick Summary

| Long Weekend | Dates Covered | Typical Workdays Off |
|--------------|---------------|----------------------|
| Family Day (Feb 20) | Feb 18–20 | Friday (Feb 18) + Monday (Feb 20) |
| Good Friday (Apr 7) | Apr 7–9 | Friday (Apr 7) + weekend |
| Victoria Day (May 22) | May 20–22 | weekend + Monday (May 22) |
| Labour Day (Sep 4) | Sep 2–4 | weekend + Monday (Sep 4) |
| Thanksgiving (Oct 9) | Oct 7–9 | weekend + Monday (Oct 9) |
| Remembrance Day (Nov 11) | Nov 9–11 | weekend + Monday (Nov 11) |
| Christmas Day (Dec 25) | Dec 23–25 | weekend + Monday (Dec 25) |

> **Tip for App Integration**  
> If you need to filter by province, use the “Province(s)” column to determine which long weekends apply to a specific user’s location. For example, Family Day is a long weekend only in certain provinces, whereas the others are nationwide.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the list broken down by province or if you need additional holiday details!
